title: Fourier degree under constant shifts
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and $c\in\mathbb{R}$. If the Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$, then the Fourier degree of the function $x\mapsto f(x)-c$ is at most $k$.
